title: Reign of Queen Nitocris (Netjerkare Siptah)
summary: CFAH AP-16: Nitocris reigned approximately 1497–1479 BC; CFAH-6 has her follow Merenre II, who died in 1491 BC.
description: CFAH AP-16: Nitocris reigned approximately 1497–1479 BC; CFAH-6 has her follow Merenre II, who died in 1491 BC.
